text_to_image_prompt: Older adult man, gray side-parted hair, rectangular thin gold-tone glasses, fuller face and body, brown tweed three-piece suit, ivory shirt, burgundy tie, brown leather shoes. Three full-body views in a horizontal row: front, right-facing side profile, back. Same height and scale in each panel. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Create a professional photographic character turnaround reference sheet for the SAME person shown in both reference images. Image 1 is the approved body proportions and full outfit; image 2 is the face identity detail. Older adult man, gray side-parted hair, rectangular thin gold-tone glasses, fuller face and body, brown tweed three-piece suit, ivory shirt, burgundy tie, brown leather shoes. Exactly THREE full-body views arranged evenly left-to-right: straight FRONT, exact 90-degree SIDE profile facing to the right, and straight BACK. Same person, SAME outfit, same head size, same limb proportions and overall height in every view. Preserve the approved leg thickness, leg-to-torso ratio, waist and build; no stretching or fashion-model redesign. Neutral standing posture, arms relaxed at sides; full hair and shoes visible in every panel. Natural perspective at eye level; seamless pure white background and subtle floor contact shadows. Unified clean realistic studio photography, detailed skin, hair and natural cloth weave, no painterly or embossed artifacts. Do not add props, change garments, add labels, text or borders. Wide landscape image, ideally 3072x2048 or maximum native available.
reproduction_note: 独立提示词为成图重建描述；严格身份一致需同时参考已确认全身图与原始肖像。实际尺寸按PNG记录，不冒称2K或4K；背面细节为生成补全。
